standard_prerequisites: B^wedge is an object of the completed category (lemma-topologically-finite-type-Noetherian of the same chapter)

I-adic completion is exact on finite modules over a polynomial ring and agrees with tensoring with the completed polynomial ring (Algebra, Lemmas algebra-lemma-completion-tensor and algebra-lemma-completion-flat)
flatness of A[x]^wedge over A[x] and of B^wedge over B
the naive cotangent complex NL(alpha) of a presentation J/J^2 to the free module of differentials (Algebra, Section algebra-section-netherlander)
core_obligations: Prove that for a finite type map A -> B with presentation alpha : A[x_1,...,x_n] -> B, the completed naive cotangent complex satisfies NL^wedge_{B^wedge/A} = lim NL(alpha) tensor_B B^wedge as complexes and NL^wedge_{B^wedge/A} = NL_{B/A} tensor^L_B B^wedge in D(B^wedge)
proof_roadmap: Completion is exact on finite modules and agrees with tensoring with the completed polynomial ring; since B^wedge = A[x]^wedge / J^wedge, the conormal module satisfies (J/J^2) tensor_B B^wedge = (J/J^2)^wedge = J^wedge/(J^wedge)^2.
This identifies NL^wedge_{B^wedge/A} with NL(alpha) tensor_B B^wedge term by term, giving the first statement.
The final statement follows because NL_{B/A} is homotopy equivalent to NL(alpha) and B -> B^wedge is flat, so the derived base change is the ordinary one.
difficulty_reason: H2: a completion bookkeeping lemma whose two identifications follow from exactness and flatness of completion.
